sourceTitle: The Dialect of the West of England; Particularly Somersetshire
description: "The Dialect of the West of England; Particularly Somersetshire" by James Jennings is a linguistic exploration written in the late 19th century. The work is a detailed examination of the Somerset dialect, featuring a glossary of terms currently used in the area, alongside poems and literary pieces that exemplify the unique linguistic features of the dialect.
